--- name: welcomeMenuSkill description: Shows a welcome menu listing the chat scenarios under the same automation label as the running scenario. ---
# Welcome Menu
Shows a welcome menu listing the chat scenarios under the same automation label as the running scenario.
## When to use
- The `<labelid>_welcome_menu_welcome` step of the `eme_server_welcome_menu` and `entity_chat_welcome_menu` scenarios. EME Server and Entity Chat open with it right away.
## How it works
1. Reads `connectedtop` (the automationlabel id) from the running scenario. 2. Finds enabled, visible, chat-enabled scenarios with the same `connectedtop`, sorted by `ordering`, excluding itself. 3. Renders the `welcome_menu` template with `menuscenarios` and `menulabel`. Each menu item runs that scenario's `<scenarioid>_confirm` step first.
## Outputs
- The rendered menu response, `menuscenarios` and `menulabel`
## Implementation
- Bean `welcomeMenuSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.WelcomeMenuSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: renderLocalTemplateSkill description: Renders the local chat template named after the current automation step and sends it as the reply. ---
# Render Local Template
Renders the local chat template named after the current automation step and sends it as the reply.
## When to use
- The reply is fixed content, such as menus, help text or confirmations, that needs no LLM call.
## How it works
1. Uses the current automation step's id as the template name. 2. Renders it with the `localrender` connection and sets it as the last response.
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The agent's chatterbox reply record; its replytoid points at the user's message
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- The rendered response
## Implementation
- Bean `renderLocalTemplateSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.RenderLocalTemplateSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: libraryCollectionChatMonitorSkill description: Reads each new team chat message, asks the LLM whether and how the assistant should help, and schedules a follow-up. ---
# Monitor Chats
Reads each new team chat message, asks the LLM whether and how the assistant should help, and schedules a follow-up.
## When to use
- The assistant should watch a team chat quietly and step in only when it is useful.
## How it works
1. Stays quiet when started by a system message (opening the chat, or Not now on a confirmation page). Otherwise loads the latest user message and stores it as `userquery`. 2. Calls the `library_collection_chat_monitor` tools function on the thinking LLM, which ranks the most likely `menuscenarios`, picks a `helperrole` and a `wait_minutes` (0–5). 3. Sleeps `wait_minutes` on its own thread. Nothing is broadcast while it waits. 4. A newer user message in the same channel cancels the wait, and that message is checked instead. If the wait finishes and no newer message arrived, it renders `chat_monitor_menu` with the recommended scenarios. Each menu item runs that scenario's `<scenarioid>_confirm` step first.
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The agent's chatterbox reply record; its replytoid points at the user's message
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `userquery`, `menuscenarios`, `recommendedscenarios`, `helperrole`, `confirmation` - `teaminstruction` and `teamcontext`: what the team asked for, kept for the confirmation page (`chatGuessGoalSkill` uses it)
## Implementation
- Bean `libraryCollectionChatMonitorSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.LibraryCollectionChatMonitorSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: openCodeJobCreatorSkill description: Plans a multi-step agent job from a user request by choosing among the documented skills and scenarios. ---
# Create Agent Jobs
Plans a multi-step agent job from a user request by choosing among the documented skills and scenarios.
## When to use
- A user asks for something that may take several skills to complete.
## How it works
1. Uses `query`, or the user's non-agent messages in the channel history. 2. Finds candidate skills and scenarios by searching the embedded `markdowncontent` of `aiskill` and `automationscenario` records. 3. Builds possible steps from each candidate's `markdowncontent`, `parameters` and `defaultoutput`, and calls the `agentJobCreator` structure. 4. If the user has not approved yet, shows the proposed plan (`agent_job_showjobplan`) and waits. 5. Once approved, saves the `agentjob` and its `agentjobstep` records and fires `agentjob/runagentjobs`.
## Inputs
- `query`: The user's request. Built from the channel history when missing - `channelchathistory`: Chat history used when `query` is not set
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `agentjob`, `proposedsteps`, `userapproved`, `possible_steps`
## Notes
- This skill reads `markdowncontent` and `parameters` from every aiskill row to pick tools, so keep them accurate.
## Implementation
- Bean `openCodeJobCreatorSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.OpenCodeJobCreatorSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: openCodeStatusSkill description: Follows an OpenCode session (or an agent job) in chat, showing progress, question forms, security prompts and the final reply. ---
# Open Code Status
Follows an OpenCode session (or an agent job) in chat, showing progress, question forms, security prompts and the final reply.
## When to use
- After `openCodeRunnerSkill` (`runafter`), to wait on its OpenCode session. - After an agent job has been started from chat, to follow the job's status. - Run again by `openCodeAnswerSkill` and `openCodeApproveSkill` after a person replies, to keep following the session.
## How it works
1. Finds the `sessionstatus`: from the runner's context, or by looking up the session for `currentagentjobstepid` or `agentjobstep`. 2. Every 2 seconds, applies new OpenCode events, saves the latest assistant text to the runner step's `markdowncontent`, and renders `agent_job_showstatus`, broadcast with `processUpdate`. A newer chat message cancels the wait. 3. If OpenCode asks a question or permission, saves the runner step as `question` or `securityprompt` with `pendingquestion`, `confirmationpendingid` and `pendingform`, renders the form or approval buttons, and stops. 4. When the session finishes, puts the final reply in `commandoutput`, renders the completed card, and returns to `startup_scenario`. Throws if OpenCode reports an error or the session runs past 20 minutes. 5. With no OpenCode session, follows the `agentjob` status instead until it is `complete` or `error` (up to 500 checks).
The rendered form and buttons post to this job's scenario (`currentscenario`), using the steps that run `openCodeAnswerSkill` (`answerfunction`) and `openCodeApproveSkill` (`approvefunction`).
## Inputs
- `sessionstatus`: The OpenCode session from `openCodeRunnerSkill` - `currentagentjobstepid`: Id of the runner step, used to find the session when resuming - `agentjob`: The agent job to report on - `startup_scenario`: The step to return to when the job finishes
## Outputs
- `sessionstatus`, `pendingform`, `commandoutput`, `markdowncontent`, `secondstaken`, `currentscenario`, `answerfunction`, `approvefunction`, and the rendered status
## Implementation
- Bean `openCodeStatusSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.OpenCodeStatusSkill` - Agent type: `eventagent`

--- name: questionsConfirmSkill description: Starts a Q&A chat about one entity, offering saved suggestions or creating new ones. ---
# Questions Chat
Starts a Q&A chat about one entity, offering saved suggestions or creating new ones.
## When to use
- A user opens the question chat on an entity.
## How it works
1. Loads the entity, its module, the guide status, and existing `aisuggestion` records. 2. Renders the template named after the current step. 3. With no suggestions, runs `question_create_suggestions`. Otherwise moves to `question_ask`.
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The agent's chatterbox reply record; its replytoid points at the user's message - `entityid`: Id of the entity - `entitymoduleid`: Module id of the entity
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `entity`, `entitymodule`, `statuses`, `suggestions`
## Implementation
- Bean `questionsConfirmSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.QuestionsConfirmSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: searchingParseSkill description: Parses the user's search request into structured search tables and keywords, or replies conversationally when it cannot. ---
# Searching Parse
Parses the user's search request into structured search tables and keywords so the following steps can run module searches and semantic matches.
## When to use
- The `<scenarioid>_parse` step of the conversational search scenarios (`entity_chat_search`, `eme_server_search_media`).
## How it works
1. Takes the automation step id and removes the `<scenarioid>_` prefix (for example `entity_chat_search_parse` is `parse`); any other action throws `Function not supported`. 2. Loads the user's message from the chatterbox record pointed to by the agent message's `replytoid` (or the `userquery` context value) and stores it as `userquery`. 3. Calls the thinking LLM with the `search_parse` structure to break the request into tables, parameters and keywords. 4. Builds an `AiSearch` with up to three steps (`table_name`, `parameters`, optional `foreign_table`). `all` means searching across modules; a missing target table falls back to the `modulesearch` module. 5. Vector-searches the `aifunctionparameter` semantic table for a more specific function match (distance < .7) and, when found, applies its parent/child module to the search steps. 6. If nothing was parsed, replies conversationally with the LLM's `friendly_response`. Otherwise sets the next automation step to `<scenarioid>_tables`.
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The agent's chatterbox reply record; its replytoid points at the user's message - `userquery`: The search request text, set from the user's message
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `userquery`, the parsed `AiSearch` parameters on the agent context, and either a conversational reply or the next step `<scenarioid>_tables`
## Implementation
- Bean `searchingParseSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.SearchingParseSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: searchingTablesSkill description: Runs the parsed module searches and renders the results table before moving on to semantic matches. ---
# Searching Tables
Runs the parsed module searches (single table, two-table join, or cross-module search) and renders the results as a table in the chat.
## When to use
- The `<scenarioid>_tables` step of the conversational search scenarios (`entity_chat_search`, `eme_server_search_media`).
## How it works
1. Takes the automation step id and removes the `<scenarioid>_` prefix; any other action throws `Function not supported`. 2. For the `tables` action, renders the local `search_tables` template (path action `AgentModule.searchTables`), which runs freeform description queries for each parsed search step — including two-step joins and the cross-module `modulesearch` fallback with asset handling — and organizes the hits through the results manager. 3. Keeps the rendered results as a message prefix and sets the next automation step to `<scenarioid>_semantic`.
Also owns the module-facing helpers used by the render templates and admin pages:
- `searchTables(WebPageRequest, AiSearch)`: executes the parsed search steps and puts `hits`/`assethits` on the request. - `organizeResults(...)`: totals the hits and loads them through the results manager. - `createPossibleFunctionParameters(log)`: builds and embeds one `aifunctionparameter` vector per module, child view and asset type (called by `AgentModule.recreateFunctions`). - `makeSearchSuggestions(UserProfile)`: up to five "Search for ... in ..." suggestions from the user's enabled modules (used by `AgentModule.loadSearchSuggestions`).
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The agent's chatterbox reply record; its replytoid points at the user's message - The parsed `AiSearch` parameters on the agent context, set by the parse step
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- The rendered results table as a message prefix and the next step `<scenarioid>_semantic`
## Implementation
- Bean `searchingTablesSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.SearchingTablesSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: searchingSemanticSkill description: Adds semantic matches for the search keywords on top of the table results, then offers related records. ---
# Searching Semantic
Finds semantically related entities and assets for the parsed search keywords and renders them in the chat.
## When to use
- The `<scenarioid>_semantic` step of the conversational search scenarios (`entity_chat_search`, `eme_server_search_media`).
## How it works
1. Takes the automation step id and removes the `<scenarioid>_` prefix; any other action throws `Function not supported`. 2. For the `semantic` action, builds a semantic query from the step keywords (or the original request with words like "search", "find", "look for" and "show me" removed). 3. When the query is not empty, renders the local `search_semantic` template (path action `AgentModule.chatAgentSemanticSearch`), which asks the `semantictopics` semantic classifier for related entity ids per module and loads them as `semanticentities`, `semanticentityhits` and `semanticassethits`. 4. When the query is empty, echoes the previous message prefix instead. 5. Sets the next automation step to `view_related_records` and fires the step status complete.
Also owns the module-facing helpers used by the render templates:
- `semanticSearch(WebPageRequest)`: loads the semantic matches for the `semanticquery` request parameter. - `semanticSearchBestMatch(query, moduleId)`: single best semantic match in a module. - `searchRelatedEntitiesBySearchCategory(searchcategory)` and `rescanSearchCategories(log)`: keep search categories' related entities up to date.
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The agent's chatterbox reply record; its replytoid points at the user's message - The parsed `AiSearch` parameters on the agent context, set by the parse step
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `semanticquery`, the rendered semantic matches as a message prefix, and the next step `view_related_records`
## Implementation
- Bean `searchingSemanticSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.SearchingSemanticSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: searchingViewRelatedSkill description: Renders the related records views for an entity after a search. ---
# View Related Records
Renders the related-records views (list and details) for an entity found by a search.
## When to use
- The `view_related_records*` steps of the conversational search scenarios, reached after the semantic step sets the next automation step to `view_related_records`.
## How it works
1. For any automation step id starting with `view_related_records`, renders the local template named by the step id (for example `view_related_records` → `AgentModule.loadRelatedRecords`, `view_related_record_list` → `AgentModule.loadRelatedRecordList`, `view_related_record_details` → `AgentModule.loadRecord`). 2. Sets the rendered response as the last response and fires the step status complete. Any other action throws `Function not supported`.
Also owns the module-facing helpers used by those render templates:
- `getRelatedRecords(entityModuleId, entityId)`: finds non-system views whose `rendertable` contains records referencing the entity, with their names and counts. - `getRelatedRecordList(entityModuleId, entityId, listId)`: the related records of one list. - `getRecord(entityModuleId, entityId, listId, recordId)`: a single related record.
## Inputs
- `entityid`: Id of the entity - `entitymoduleid`: Module id of the entity
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- The rendered related records views as the step response
## Implementation
- Bean `searchingViewRelatedSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.SearchingViewRelatedSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`
